caption:
Today's Sky is Yang Metal, The Raw Blade ⚡ Pause on your Day Master.

Your Day Master is the element of the day you were born. Today's sharp edge meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yang Metal gets a friend day, Yin Water feels supported, Yang Wood feels the pressure.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

Which one is your Monday? Comment below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #astrology #selfdiscovery #astrologer #selfawareness #bazi #fiveelements #chinesemetaphysics #singapore
day_line: A raw blade on a Dragon day. Sharp and ambitious: good for clear starts, watch the bluntness.

lines.Yang Wood: Monday cuts a bit close today. Clear one big task by noon; the rest gets easier.
lines.Yin Wood: Your name comes up in a good way today. Be ready with a one-line update.
lines.Yang Fire: A fresh lead shows up today. Follow it up before the inbox buries it.
lines.Yin Fire: Set up the week's money plan today. Small, boring, works.
lines.Yang Earth: You're in a good mood today. Spread it around, and still hit the deadline.
lines.Yin Earth: You'll spot what's wrong in the plan today. Say it with a fix attached.
lines.Yang Metal: Your crowd is in sync today. Split the work fairly; nobody likes a solo hero.
lines.Yin Metal: Someone takes the good desk or the last seat today. Shrug and find a better corner.
lines.Yang Water: Your gut has the answer today. Note it before the first meeting starts.
lines.Yin Water: Help comes from someone senior today. Ask the question you think is too basic.
